comment:
* This class is used to represent a Resource that has been loaded
 * from the class path.
 *
 * @author  David Connelly
 * @since   1.2

methods.name: public abstract String getName()
methods.comment: * Returns the name of the Resource.

methods.name: public abstract URL getURL()
methods.comment: * Returns the URL of the Resource.

methods.name: public abstract URL getCodeSourceURL()
methods.comment: * Returns the CodeSource URL for the Resource.

methods.name: public abstract InputStream getInputStream() throws IOException
methods.comment: * Returns an InputStream for reading the Resource data.

methods.name: public abstract int getContentLength() throws IOException
methods.comment: * Returns the length of the Resource data, or -1 if unknown.

methods.name: private synchronized InputStream cachedInputStream() throws IOException
methods.comment: Cache result in case getBytes is called after getByteBuffer.

methods.name: public byte[] getBytes() throws IOException
methods.comment: * Returns the Resource data as an array of bytes.

methods.name: public ByteBuffer getByteBuffer() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the Resource data as a ByteBuffer, but only if the input stream
     * was implemented on top of a ByteBuffer. Return <tt>null</tt> otherwise.

methods.name: public Manifest getManifest() throws IOException
methods.comment: * Returns the Manifest for the Resource, or null if none.

methods.name: public java.security.cert.Certificate[] getCertificates()
methods.comment: * Returns theCertificates for the Resource, or null if none.

methods.name: public CodeSigner[] getCodeSigners()
methods.comment: * Returns the code signers for the Resource, or null if none.

methodNames: public abstract InputStream getInputStream() throws IOException
public abstract int getContentLength() throws IOException
private synchronized InputStream cachedInputStream() throws IOException
